version.approval_notes: Enterprise-managed, unlisted Firefox MV2 automation companion. Installation and transmission consent are provided by enterprise force-install policy. Only chatgpt.com and a same-host Docker bridge service named driver are permitted. A persistent background page connects outbound to ws://driver:8080/ws using an administrator-provisioned managed-storage token. The unencrypted socket is restricted to the private bridge on the same host; it is not an Internet transport and is never routed by the public proxy. External agent traffic terminates HTTPS and uses a distinct API key. No runtime secrets are embedded in this package. All executable code is packaged. Remote messages are validated command data only. The tabs.eval command accepts only predefined read-only probes and rejects script/code/expression input. Cookies permission enables contextual identities; the extension does not read ChatGPT cookies. The placeholder storage probe reads only the fixed, non-sensitive localStorage.kasm_probe marker on the private driver origin. Page text and typed input are transmitted to the administrator-controlled driver only on request. No telemetry, tracking, remote scripts, CSP relaxation, or userScripts API. Source is plain JavaScript with no build/transpile step. Review notes and setup are in docs/extension.md in the source repository. Do not use any personal login to test; internal placeholder pages exercise the protocol. Final signature acceptance is verified by stock Firefox Release policy installation.
